How It Works

From your measurements to a finished window

Send Claire your window measurements using the guide below, along with the style you have in mind, and she will prepare a quote for your curtains, pelmets, Roman blinds, voiles or any made-to-measure soft furnishing.

  • Measure width and drop using the guide below
  • Request a quote — Claire replies by email
  • Payment plan available: 20% deposit, balance within 4 months
Request a Quote

Before You Order

The Measuring Guide

Two dimensions are all Claire needs — the Width and the Drop. Take your time, and use a steel tape where possible, as plastic tapes can stretch.

1 Measuring the Width

The width you need is the length of your pole or track, not including the finials.

  • For new poles, allow an additional 15cm either side of the window reveal.
  • Always measure at least 3 different positions across the width, and use the shortest measurement.
  • Use a steel tape where possible — plastic tapes can stretch.

2 Measuring the Drop

Decide where your curtains should finish, then measure to that point:

A1cm above your window sill
B15–20cm below your window sill
C2cm above your radiator
D1cm above your floor finish

3 Tracks

For tracks, always measure from the top of the track — for both the width and the drop.

4 Poles & Headings

  • Pencil pleat & pinch pleat headings: measure from the bottom of the underside of the pole ring.
  • Tab top or eyelet curtains: measure from the top of the pole, ignoring finials — exactly as for a track.

Request a Quote

Tell Claire about your window and what you'd love made. She replies by email with your quote.

Good to know

Made to order: please allow 3–4 weeks for your window dressings to be made.

Delivery: dispatch to the UK and Republic of Ireland only.

Payment: major debit/credit cards and PayPal. A payment plan is available — 20% deposit, with the balance payable within 4 months.

Returns: as every piece is handmade to order, returns aren't accepted except where an item arrives damaged in transit or a personalisation error is made by us — please advise within 24 hours and return within 7 working days.

About Drape Expectations

A one-woman workshop in Gloucestershire, where every curtain, cot set and keepsake is handmade to order.

Claire's Story

Handmade, personal, made to order

“I'm Claire, I have over 20 years experience in needlework and drapery. I am based in Gloucestershire and I always maintain designer standards. My creations range from curtains, from simple to elaborate. Blinds, from plain to intricate, cushions, personalised cot sets and nursery items, baby rompers, bloomers, coats, dresses, leggings and small gifts.”

Nothing at Drape Expectations sits on a shelf waiting. Every order is cut, sewn and finished by Claire after you place it — which is why we ask you to allow 3–4 weeks, and why each piece arrives made for your home, and your little one, alone.
